title: CT-012 object compatibility
description: The tables CT-012 states, as data. Not a document shape like the other contracts: what this contract constrains is which objects exist and what becomes what, so the machine-readable form is the tables themselves and validate/check_object_compatibility.py reads them.

dispositions.read: accepted as it stands; its connectivity is explicit and its points are its own
dispositions.convert: accepted after one named conversion, whose cost is stated and recorded on the @Dataset
dispositions.decompose: not one dataset; it is taken apart into the parts of one @Case
dispositions.refuse: named and refused. Never approximated, never silently emptied

vtkPolyData.note: explicit connectivity in four cell arrays - verts, lines, polys, strips - read in that order so a cell index means here what it means in the file

vtkUnstructuredGrid.note: explicit connectivity of any cell type; the shape every conversion below targets

vtkPointSet.reason: points with no cells, and no reader in this build produces one: a point cloud arrives as a vtkPolyData of vertex cells, which is read. Marking it read as well would be a second path with nothing behind it, and the check that found this said so

vtkStructuredGrid.costs: connectivity becomes explicit, so memory grows by the connectivity array the file did not store; no value changes and no cell is added

vtkRectilinearGrid.costs: the three coordinate vectors become one explicit point array; memory grows from O(nx+ny+nz) to O(nx*ny*nz) and no value changes

vtkImageData.costs: origin and spacing are implicit in the file and explicit afterwards; both are recorded on the @Dataset because after the conversion nothing can recover them, and a spacing is the one number in a voxel result that carries a length unit

vtkStructuredPoints.via: as vtkImageData, of which it is the older name

vtkUniformGrid.costs: as vtkImageData, and its blanking becomes HIDDENCELL in the ghost array rather than being dropped - a blanked cell is a cell the file said to ignore, not a cell that is absent

vtkExplicitStructuredGrid.costs: the i,j,k address of each cell is lost unless it is kept as a cell field; a reservoir result is usually reported by that address

vtkHyperTreeGrid.costs: the tree is the compression; expanding it produces one cell per leaf and the memory is what the format existed to avoid. The cost is stated against LIM-002 before the conversion runs, never after

vtkCellGrid.costs: the discontinuous-Galerkin basis does not survive: the conversion writes linear sub-cells. INV-009 therefore forbids reporting a number from the converted form, and the conversion is offered for display while the numbers wait for a path that reads the basis

vtkTable.note: a @Case with no geometry. It is a source for a @Graph and never a View object; asking it for a mesh is refused rather than answered with an empty one

vtkPartitionedDataSet.note: partitions of a single dataset. They recombine, so they are one part with a partition count - the case INV-010 governs

vtkMultiPieceDataSet.note: as vtkPartitionedDataSet, under its older name

vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection.into: one part per dataset, each with its own partitions
vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection.note: the type that states both levels at once, and the reason a part and a partition are two words here

vtkMultiBlockDataSet.into: one part per leaf block, keeping the block names as the part hierarchy
vtkMultiBlockDataSet.note: the most common CAE reader output (E-133). Its blocks are distinct parts - an element block, a side set, a material - and not partitions of one mesh, so nothing sums across them without being asked

vtkOverlappingAMR.reason: the levels overlap by construction: a refined region is present at every level above it, so a sum over the leaves counts it once per level. Until the level masking is read and applied, every aggregate over one is wrong by an amount that looks plausible - INV-010 one level up

vtkNonOverlappingAMR.reason: no reader in this build produces one, and accepting a type nothing can deliver would be an untested path pretending to be support

vtkUniformGridAMR.reason: as vtkOverlappingAMR, of which it is the base

vtkHierarchicalBoxDataSet.reason: deprecated in the toolkit and superseded by vtkOverlappingAMR

vtkPath.reason: a two-dimensional drawing path used by the text renderer, not result geometry, although it is a vtkDataSet

vtkMolecule.reason: atoms and bonds are a different domain with their own units and their own conventions; reading one as a mesh of vertices would show it and mean nothing

vtkGraph.reason: a topology with no geometry this product can report on

vtkSelection.reason: a description of a subset, not data; it is an argument to an operation and never a @Case

vtkAnnotation.reason: a selection with a label; annotations here are CT-004 state, not read data

vtkArrayData.reason: n-dimensional arrays with no association to points or cells, so INV-003 has nothing to hold

vtkBSPCuts.reason: a spatial partitioning tree used by parallel filters, not a result

vtkPiecewiseFunction.reason: a transfer function - appearance, and already CT-004 state

vtkDataObject.reason: the base class. A reader returning one has told us nothing about what it read, which is a reason to stop rather than to guess

vtkGenericDataSet.reason: an adaptor interface with no storage of its own

vtkGeoJSONFeature.reason: geographic features carry their own coordinate reference systems, which this product does not model

vtkCartesianGrid.reason: present in the toolkit's type table and produced by no reader in this build

vtkStatisticalModel.reason: a fitted model, not measured data

vtkCompositeDataSet.reason: the composite base class; as vtkDataObject

vtkDataObjectTree.reason: the composite tree base class; as vtkDataObject

vtkDataSet.reason: the dataset base class; as vtkDataObject

vtkUnstructuredGridBase.reason: an abstract base with no storage

vtkTemporalDataSet.reason: obsolete in the toolkit; time is a @Case axis here, not a data object

analysisMesh.note: the only object a reported number may come from, and the reason the type exists separately from referenceMesh

referenceMesh.requires: geometry, from a @Dataset or an imported prop
referenceMesh.note: scenery with a shape. A dimension drawn against it is a drawing, not a measurement

scalarField.requires: an analysisMesh and one single-component @Field on it

vectorField.requires: an analysisMesh and one @Field of two or more components on it

trajectory.requires: an analysisMesh, a seed set and an integrator; it is produced, not read
trajectory.note: a streamline, particle trace or path line. Its own geometry is a result of a computation whose parameters CT-004 records (view/REQ-018)

pointCloud.requires: points, with no cells or with vertex cells only

annotation.requires: nothing geometric; a text, point label, scale bar or dimension
annotation.note: it may show a number, which is computed from the @Dataset and never measured off the picture (INV-001)

conversions.note: Every ordered pair of view object types appears. A pair that is not allowed says why, because a table with holes is read as a table whose holes are permitted.

allowed.note: one direction only. The result may never source a reported number, which is the whole difference between the two types

allowed.drops: every cell, and with them every cell field
allowed.note: point fields survive because they are indexed by points, which is what remains

allowed.requires: the @Field the scalarField draws has two or more components; a one-component field is refused rather than promoted to a vector of length one
a named component or magnitude from the derived-quantity catalogue, which is a computation with an identifier and not a change of appearance (15_derived_quantities.md)

refusedReasons.identity: an object is already what it is; a conversion to its own type is not offered, so that a no-op cannot be mistaken for an accepted request
refusedReasons.inventsConnectivity: the target needs cells the source does not have, and meshing them is an invention with a tolerance - a different result wearing the same name
refusedReasons.inventsData: the target needs a @Field the source does not carry, and no default may stand in for one (XC-001)
refusedReasons.wouldLaunder: the source may not be a source of reported numbers and the target may, so the conversion would make a drawing into a measurement
refusedReasons.differentKind: one is geometry and the other is not; there is nothing to convert, only something to create
refusedReasons.derivedNotConverted: the target is produced from the source and does not replace it - a scalar field, a vector field and a trajectory each need an analysisMesh that goes on existing
